# Mermaid → Sirena compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by `go test ./ingest/mermaid` (TestCompatMatrix_DocUpToDate).
     Do not edit by hand — change compatSamples in compat_matrix_test.go and run
     `UPDATE_COMPAT_MATRIX=1 go test ./ingest/mermaid` to regenerate. -->

Sirena ingests Mermaid **flowcharts** (`graph` / `flowchart`) into its typed IR
and renders them to deterministic SVG. This matrix classifies how representative
Mermaid features survive that ingestion.

**This is a structural-fidelity matrix, not a pixel-parity claim.** Sirena applies
its own layout and theme; output never aims to match Mermaid's pixels.

Outcomes:

- **full** — every node and edge is represented; no diagnostics.
- **styling-dropped** — geometry survives; styling directives (`style`, `classDef`,
  `linkStyle`, `click`) have no sirena equivalent and are dropped.
- **partial** — the flowchart renders but some statements were dropped (parse errors
  or unsupported statement types). Rare: malformed input usually classifies as
  *unsupported* instead, because the flowchart node fails to parse at all.
- **unsupported** — nothing renders; the input is not a flowchart (e.g.
  `sequenceDiagram`, `pie`, `gantt`).

| Feature | Sample | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Flowchart (graph / flowchart) | `graph TD; A --> B` | full |
| Flow directions (TD, LR, RL, BT) | `flowchart LR; A --> B` | full |
| Labeled edges | `graph TD; A -->\|yes\| B` | full |
| Node shapes (rect, round, circle) | `graph TD; A[rect] --> B(round); B --> C((circle))` | full |
| Decision / rhombus node | `graph TD; A{decision} --> B[ok]` | full |
| Subgraphs | `graph TD; subgraph G; A --> B; end` | full |
| Edge variants (dotted, thick) | `graph LR; A -.-> B; B ==> C` | full |
| style directive | `graph TD; A --> B; style A fill:#f00` | styling-dropped |
| classDef + class | `graph TD; A --> B; classDef big fill:#f00; class A big` | styling-dropped |
| linkStyle directive | `graph LR; A --> B; linkStyle 0 stroke:#f00` | styling-dropped |
| click / interaction | `graph TD; A --> B; click A "https://x"` | styling-dropped |
| sequenceDiagram | `sequenceDiagram; A->>B: hi` | unsupported |
| pie chart | `pie; "a" : 10` | unsupported |
| gantt chart | `gantt; title X` | unsupported |

This matrix reflects the tested samples in `compat_matrix_test.go`; it is
representative, not exhaustive. The classifier behind it is `mermaid.Classify`.
